parameters.name: num_candidates
parameters.description: Number of candidates in the pool

parameters.name: num_periods
parameters.description: Number of periods in the planning horizon

parameters.name: minimum_total_experience
parameters.description: Minimum total project management experience required

parameters.name: project_management_experience
parameters.description: Project management experience of each candidate

parameters.name: incompatible_pair_a
parameters.description: First candidate index in each incompatible pair

parameters.name: incompatible_pair_b
parameters.description: Second candidate index in each incompatible pair

variables.name: selected_candidate
variables.description: Binary selection decision for each candidate

constraints.name: binary_selection_domain
constraints.description: Each candidate selection decision must be binary

constraints.name: budget_limit
constraints.description: Selected candidates must have total salary within the available budget

constraints.name: hire_count_limit
constraints.description: The number of selected candidates must not exceed the maximum hires

constraints.name: skill_requirement
constraints.description: Selected candidates must meet the minimum total skill requirement

constraints.name: experience_requirement
constraints.description: Selected candidates must meet the minimum total project management experience requirement

constraints.name: incompatibility_pairwise_limit
constraints.description: For each incompatible pair, at most one candidate may be selected

constraints.name: single_stage_no_carryover
constraints.description: The planning horizon is informational only; the model is a single-stage selection problem with no period-indexed decisions or carryover state.
constraints.formula: \text{No period-indexed variables or carryover state are introduced; decisions are modeled only by } x_i,\ i=0,\dots,N-1

constraints.name: total_salary_definition
constraints.description: Define total salary as the sum of salaries of selected candidates

constraints.name: total_skill_definition
constraints.description: Define total skill as the sum of skill levels of selected candidates

constraints.name: total_experience_definition
constraints.description: Define total project management experience as the sum of experiences of selected candidates

objectives.name: salary_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total salary of the selected candidates while satisfying all hiring requirements

final_objective.description: Minimize the total salary of selected candidates while satisfying all hiring requirements; this is a single-objective MILP.
